articles.title: Pakistan sugar export tender fails to attract bids as reserve price exceeds global rates
articles.description: The Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) has failed to receive a single bid for the export of 107,739 metric tonnes (MT) of imported white refined sugar, as its reserve price was significantly higher than prevailing international market rates, reported Pakistan Today. The state-owned trader had issued the tender on September 6 following directions from the […] ChiniMandi

articles.title: GMDA floats ₹776 crore SPR elevated road project tender, CM holds project review
articles.description: Gurugram:The Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA) on Thursday floated a tender for construction of the first phase of the elevated Southern Peripheral Road (SPR) from Vatika Chowk to the Dwarka Expressway cloverleaf on the Delhi-Gurgaon Expressway, officials said
